title: 螳螂劫掠者 Thri-kreen Predator
body:
**螳螂劫掠者 Thri-kreen Predator**
「我和我的伙伴，为了生存，我们学会了打猎。在这些日子里，我猎杀会说话和思考的人。但我必须这样做，因为我必须生存。」

**前提条件：螳螂人**

Some thri-kreen fully hone their natural physiology, turning their bodies into weapons deadlier than the gythka. They strengthen their extra arms for making claw attacks, practice graceful jumps with their powerful legs, and augment their natural venom so it is potent enough to take down tough prey. Because of their battle prowess, these kreen often become the strongest members of their packs. It is the thri-kreen way to challenge weaker leaders, and the greatest hunters rise to positions of leadership.

As you grow into the role of thri-kreen predator, you become larger and tougher, with thicker chitinous plates and stronger limbs. Along with these physical changes, your instincts and racial memories become more acute. You sense the long lineage of the kreen, and you understand the great hunts of the past and the long-forgotten tactics that let your race survive the most dangerous periods of Athasian history.

For some thri-kreen, these changes are natural—a hereditary gift. Others use psionic powers or martial training to strengthen themselves. Some find the predator's path after being exposed to sites or objects of power that stirred deep racial memories. No matter what triggered your transformation, you have become a kreen among kreen.

title: 提夫林地狱行者 Tiefling Hellstalker
body:
**提夫林地狱行者 Tiefling Hellstalker**
「Manifestations of the darkest flames of Hell cover me. You'll see the genuine article soon enough.」

**前提条件：提夫林，游荡者**

Supernatural might comes naturally to a tiefling. Blood tied to the dark history of devils makes the reason for this obvious. In a vestigial form, this power lends vehemence to a tiefling's retaliation against attackers. History has shown that a tiefling who wishes to do so can reach inward for even more power, manifesting it in a variety of ways.

Those ways are mirrored in devils and their home. When mortals speak of the Nine Hells, they refer to fire, smoke, and the burning wrath of fiends. But the truth is more complex. The hells have ice, storms, and shadow. They even have combinations of these, the elements mixing in strange and unnatural ways to produce oddities such as lightless fire.

Some tieflings prefer to live up to expectations, displaying talent with anger and flame. They evoke terror by playing the devil's part. But they lack subtlet y, which is a devil's best tool. They fail to acknowledge that mortals most fear what they can't see.

Drawing on the darkness within, a darkness that extends from the hells, a tiefling can gain uncanny advantages against enemies. Eyes can be dimmed, darkness and invisibility can be pierced, and flesh can be burned without light.

You know this, because you have learned to summon the darkness enshrouding your soul. By coupling it with your deadly martial skills, you become a terror in lightless halls under the earth, as well as on shadowed streets and in moonless wilds. Where light does find you, you snuff it in the sight of your foes. Eventually, the shadows you call up will be able to, at times, burn your enemies like extraplanar blackfire.

title: 提夫林战魔 Tiefling Warfiend
body:
**提夫林战魔 Tiefling Warfiend**
「吾之愤怒高贵无比，然怒火仍在恶魔之心内燃烧！」

**前提条件：提夫林，战士**

魔鬼与凡人的结合创造了提夫林，他们的血脉之中永远都流淌着被污染的恶魔之血。但在这堕落之中的是力量，就如同其他的力量一样，可以被用于正途或邪道。

长久以来，提夫林让这股邪恶能量在他们的灵魂内燃烧。最基本的用途就是，地狱之力可以让提夫林将愤怒和对复仇的渴望化为比平常猛烈数倍的攻击。在过去的岁月中，提夫林战士们已经掌握了一种技巧，可以将他们的负面情绪化为战争中的强大工具。

拜尔图拉斯王朝的核心几乎全都是由那些能够将自己的恶魔之怒化为武技的强大战士构成的。尽管帝国后来破灭了，然而一些魔鬼斯的战士们却幸存了下来。他们的战斗传统仍然代代相传，延续了数个世纪。今日，少数的提夫林战士依然接受这种训练，成为一个战魔，以便能够控制他们内心的魔鬼。而另一些，那些没有经过训练的提夫林，则认为最好是通过暴力来宣泄他们内心的恶魔，以免伤及他人。

许多你的族人害怕潜伏在他们灵魂深处的污点，但是你认识到，那只不过是一种你可以支配的工具而已。无需投向邪恶的怀抱，你就可以掌握你的恶魔之力。你将从血统继承来可怖力量与致命的战斗技巧结合在一起，用来保护你的伙伴，并且让那些敢于与你为敌的人付出代价。现在，你与生俱来的堕落力量已经为你而战，致命的地狱之炎缠绕着你的武器，那些垂死挣扎的敌人的微不足道的力量在它面前转瞬即被摧毁。

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点以进行额外动作时，若你在此遭遇中已经用掉了⟦地狱之怒 Infernal Wrath⟧这项种族威能，则你恢复此威能的使用。

title: 天赋元素法师 Favored Sha'ir
body:
**天赋元素法师 Favored Sha'ir**

**前提条件：法师（元素法师）**

Your rapport with the elemental powers has grown to such a degree that they regard you as one of their own. Throughout the heroic tier, you established yourself as an able partner, ally, and, perhaps, servant of the elemental powers and in doing so earned greater and greater elemental rewards, including advanced arcane knowledge and more powerful spells. So armed, you stand ready to face even greater threats and reap even greater rewards.

The elemental powers' favor grants you deeper insights into elemental magic. Not only can your gen servant fetch potent spells, but you can pierce the barriers between the planes to draw forth power to serve your needs. Such command over creation's fundamental forces translates into an improved gen servant that, at your command, can manifest the Elemental Chaos's unruly energies in effective and dangerous ways. Not only does your gen servant improve, but when you master all the elemental gifts, you can transform your servant into a powerful elemental monolith.

**11级：元素回撤 Elemental Retreat**

By proving your worth to the genies, you have earned their aid when the situation turns dire. You can manifest the elemental magic that they have bestowed on you to create a doorway through which you can step to gain succor. When you return moments later, you do so charged with the might of the Plane Below.

⟦元素回撤 Elemental Retreat⟧

**11级：灵魔行动 Gen Action**

The bond between you and your familiar strengthens. When you push past your normal limits, a surge of elemental magic transports you both.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在此额外动作之前或之后，你和你的魔宠都能以一个自由动作传送最多5格

**11级：巨灵之怒 Wrath of the Genies**

You have risen so far in the genies' esteem that they are ready to lend a hand if you need it. Wrath of the genies demonstrates how their interest can manifest in a sudden, destructive burst around your familiar.

⟦巨灵之怒 Wrath of the Genies⟧

**12级：混乱之潮 Chaos Tide**

Chaos courses through all elemental power, and its influence is what gives elemental magic its unpredictable characteristics. Learning to draw more and more upon the Plane Below can twist reality and toss about the creatures in your presence.

⟦混乱之潮 Chaos Tide⟧

**16级：元素典范 Elemental Paragon**

Elemental power suffuses your familiar. It is this power that lets you exert your will over the chaos welling up from the Plane Below. As you become more adept, so too does your familiar, which bestows an elemental boon on you.

**增益：**根据你「灵魔仆从」选择的魔宠，你获得一个增益。

土魔：当你的魔宠处于被动模式且你以奥术随意攻击威能命中时，你可以同时推离目标最多等同于你体质调整值的格数

风魔：当你的魔宠处于被动模式且你以奥术随意攻击威能命中时，你可以同时滑动目标最多2格

炎魔：当你的魔宠处于被动模式且你以奥术随意攻击威能命中时，目标受到等同于你体质调整值的额外火焰伤害

水魔：当你的魔宠处于被动模式且你以奥术随意攻击威能命中时，你和每个邻近你的盟友能以一个自由动作快步最多等同于你体质调整值的格数

其他魔宠：当你的魔宠处于被动模式且你以奥术随意攻击威能命中时，你可以传送最多等同于你体质调整值的格数

**20级：巨兽解封 Unleash Monolith**

The genies' interest in you continues to increase, and with this attention comes even greater rewards. If you have need, you can call upon their favor to transform your familiar into an elemental monolith. The elemental breaks free from the familiar’s form, its normal appearance melting away as the towering elemental comes into existence. The monolith obeys your every command and lurches forth to crush your enemies.

⟦巨兽解封 Unleash Monolith⟧

title: 天国盗跖 Heavenly Deceiver
body:
**天国盗跖 Heavenly Deceiver**
//

**前提条件：天族**

At 11th level, your veilwalker deva takes on the heavenly deceiver paragon path. You walk just this side of a boundary thinner than the finest veil and develop an affinity for the deceptive magic of the rakshasa even as the memories of past incarnations become distant. You choose your path to take advantage of this power and wield it against evil; or perhaps you are on a path dictated by your carelessness—because the intentionally evil would already be beyond redemption. You bear patterns on your skin distinct from those on most devas. The colors are always darker and include more red than their incorruptible brethren. The patterns made by the colorations are sharper, more sudden, and more violent than the simple elegance of other devas.

The longer you remain a veilwalker, the greater a command over illusion and deceit that balancing act grants you. Manipulation of others becomes an art and a second nature to you.

**11级：欺诈行动 Deceitful Action**

Stealth might be your best tool at times, so you cloak yourself from the eyes of others to better achieve your ends.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你隐形直到你下一回合结束或直到你进行一次攻击。

**11级：蛇佬腔 Snake-Tongued Mastery**

Words are more than tools. With you, they can form reality—for others and only for a time. Your ability to deceive others allows you to twist how another perceives its environment.

**增益：**你在唬骗检定上获得+2加值，并且你获得⟦欺诈影像 Deceitful Image⟧威能。

**11级：幻影鞘击 Illusion-Sheathed Strike**

Your mastery over how others perceive you twists within the minds of your foes, causing them painful mental distress as you attack. Your strikes also cause them to retreat from you.

⟦幻影鞘击 Illusion-Sheathed Strike⟧

**12级：重复幻象 Duplicate Image**

Are you where you appear to be? or are you standing slightly to the left of yourself? As you hone your ability to deceive others, you can also present others with a twin of yourself to fool their senses and make them doubt their senses.

⟦重复幻象 Duplicate Image⟧

**16级：欺诈地形 Deceitful Terrain**

By altering the perceptions of others, you can cause them to avoid illusory hazards. of course, you choose what they see, so you also control how they adjust their positions.

**增益：**当你开始你的回合时，你能以一个自由动作滑动一个邻近你的敌人到一个邻近你的非妨害地形的格子。

**20级：孤独幻象 Illusion of Solitude**

title: 天空猎手 Sky Hunter
prerequisite: 德鲁伊，⟦野性变身 Wild Shape⟧威能
body:
**天空猎手 Sky Hunter**
「鹰是完美的捕食者，不被大地所束缚，如原始精魂般狩猎。」

**前提条件：德鲁伊，⟦野性变身 Wild Shape⟧威能**

虽然太初之兽通常以哺乳动物猎食者的形态现身，但有时候也会以羽翼翱翔于天空，在空中狩猎。鹰和猎鹰作为猎食者比起豹或狼毫不逊色，有些德鲁伊使用这些猛禽的形态进行狩猎。

你就是这样的德鲁伊，模仿鸟类的方式狩猎的天空猎手。在野性形态下你无法一直飞行，但可以时不时飞起，有的德鲁伊使用有点像鸡蛇――拥有使其能够短距飞行的不完善翅膀的潜猎者――的野兽形态。其他的则保持原有的野兽形态，只有使用天空猎手的能力时才化为鸟型。

title: 天空学者 Celestial Scholar

body:
**天空学者 Celestial Scholar**
「在太阳的金色大厅里，我闪耀着光芒。在月亮的暗室里，我欺骗了心灵。在苍穹中，我是最明亮的星星。」

**前提条件：术士，「宇宙魔法」职业特性**

The tradition of the celestial scholar is more academic than the paths of other cosmic sorcerers, and definitely more cerebral than the paths of other types of sorcerers. title: 天命兵器 Weapon of Fortune
prerequisite: 神罚使，⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧威能
body:
**天命兵器 Weapon of Fortune**
「一切都归结到机会：是我活还是你死？」

**前提条件：神罚使，⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧威能**

You are a servant of a deity of luck, and you completely trust your own good fortune. As a symbol of your devotion to chance, you always carry a set of dice with you. When in doubt, you trust the dice to determine your actions. Just like the wind, you can be gentle and complacent or a dangerous storm capable of destroying those who stand in your way. Although you are always unpredictable, you can be a brave and loyal companion; fortune brought your company together, after all, and you know better than most that great deeds often flow from unlikely friendships or chance meetings.

You are probably a worshiper of Avandra or a similar deity. Your purpose is to inspire people to be daring, to take chances and seize opportunities, for those who take no risks never realize their full potential. In battle, you have learned to rely on chance. You are a potent combatant when luck favors you.

Although you might not represent the typical image of a divine servant, you are nonetheless a faithful devotee of your deity and your beliefs. You have little regard for the strictures of formal worship—you're more likely to be found gambling in a tavern than praying in a temple. But when chance leads you to down the path to adventure or into a situation that demands action, you don't hesitate to join the fight. After all, that's what's the dice told you to do.

**11级：天眷幸运 Fortune Favors the Fortunate**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，掷一个d6。如果结果是6，则你照常进行额外动作，但是不消耗此行动点，且你可以在此遭遇中再花费一个行动点。

**11级：我赌了 I'll Take that Bet**

**增益：**当你受到重击或你⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧的目标造成重击时，你可以用一个自由动作掷一个d6。如果结果是1，则你受到2d6伤害。如果结果是5或6，则此重击变成普通命中。

⟦运气大于技术 Luck, Not Skill⟧

**12级：恩赐标记 Signs of Favor**

title: 天使化身 Angelic Aspect
body:
**天使化身 Angelic Aspect**
「吾为侍奉吾神之天使。」

**前提条件：神导士**

在众神对抗魔神的上古战争中，神导士是众神在凡间最信赖的仆人，他们被允许使用最纯粹的神圣力量，就如同神的不朽使者――天使一样。在那些时日中，最受宠信的凡人神导士和天使之间的区别是极难分辨的。一些神导士吸收了太多的神圣能量，令他们的外表看起来仿佛天使。而与之相对的，一些天使主动将体内的神圣精能散去，并穿起了凡人的服饰扮成神导士，这些天使自愿将力量抑制下去，以便能够作为神的使者更好地在凡间活动并侍奉神。

你是这众多典范之道中的一员，这指引你到达新的方向：你既非完全的天使也非完全的人类，而是两者的合体。作为一名天使化身，你以凡人之体引导神圣能量，从而显现出天使的特性：你对光明与黑暗力量有特殊的抵抗力，你的令人敬畏的外貌让试图攻击你的人感到深深的恐惧，你生出双翼展翅翱翔飞越战场，你的攻击犹如天使一样威力无匹。

若你生为凡人，则你的转变已经开始，你已经踏入了天界的门槛，并将转化为更强大的不朽生灵。若你曾经生为天使但隐藏于凡人的躯壳之下，则这层掩盖正在缓缓褪去，而你原本的真实面目逐渐显露出来。无论是何者，都足以令你的敌人在你面前恐惧战栗。

You have long harbored a divine spark within yourself, a subtle shard of your god's essence. Long has it lain dormant, but as you dispatch your enemies and see your oaths through, the essence awakens and infuses your body with astral brilliance until your mortal shell transmutes into something greater than what it once was. Your deeds are the catalyst for your transformation into a favored soul. Once you set foot on this glorious path, you ever after carry with you the blessings of your god.

Becoming a favored soul triggers several physical changes, specifically the appearance of feathery wings that grow, almost overnight, from your back. These wings have strength enough to bear your weight. Your feathers can be any color you like. As you continue down this path, your body lightens, your bones becoming hollow and strong so you can fly more easily without sacrificing your durability. **铁星重锤手 Ironstar Mauler**
「Aggression is the key to victory. Get in there and start mixing it up while your enemy is still trying to decide if it wants to fight or not. Hesitation is a luxury we can't afford.」

**前提条件：战士，⟦铁星学徒 <流派初成> Ironstar Student <Lesser Style>⟧专长**

You are a battle-tested master of the Ironstar combat style. You wield a mace or a flail as easily as a graceful elf duelist wields a rapier; in your hands, these cruel weapons are as light and quick as willow switches. You have spent countless hours attaining the necessary balance, concentration, and intuition to use these weapons effectively. With uncanny precision, you can crumple a shield, break a weapon-hand, shatter fangs, or crush a skull.

Beyond mastering the style's pure physical technique, you have absorbed the attitude and mindset of the Ironstar masters. Your chosen style is more than pure strength and savagery. You recognize that fearlessness, intimidation, and aggression are weapons every bit as important as the maces or flails you wield.

Warriors of different races and lands have developed techniques similar to yours, but none have studied them more carefully—or practiced them more fiercely—than the dwarf masters who originated the Ironstar technique. 「These roughnecks bow to no king, but they do follow me. Under my command, they can go anywhere and do anything. What do you need?」

**前提条件：督军**

Sometimes a small squad of specially trained or highly skilled people can do what an army can't. A precise strike or a cunning raid can turn the tide in many dangerous situations. Numerous nobles and mercantile interests keep or patronize assault teams such as these for situations that call for decisive offensive action. A unit of such specialists can instead become its own employer, attacking and looting monster lairs on the borderlands and becoming rich in the process. Another such group might itself become a menace, turning superior combat prowess toward banditry or tyranny.

The world is in a dark age. Desperate times favor resourceful people. But even bold and venturesome folk need wily leadership to thrive. Such a leader helps a team hit hard and stay mobile, avoiding obstacles, overcoming foes, and keeping one step ahead of the enemy. In fact, precision command and an eye toward stealth can make all the difference in smallsquad engagements.

You are such a leader, whether through formal training in elite unit command or as a result of direct experience, or both. Those who observe you might say you're the team's commander, but you see yourself as an expert facilitator among able peers. You know the skills of those with whom you work, and you always have the right trick to keep the whole party in fighting shape. The cohesion you have created among your comrades has seen you through much in the past, and it speaks of your future success.

title: 突击骑兵 Shock Trooper
body:
**突击骑兵 Shock Trooper**
「快速移动！给他们致命打击」

**前提条件：战士**

Nerath was a just nation, it is said, but it would be a lie to say that it was built solely through negotiation, the spread of knowledge, and cultural influence. No, as any historian can tell you, Nerath rose on the splintered shields and shattered blades of its soldiers. When an object of conquest doesn't bend, it must be made to bow.

That was the job of Nerath's legions. Those armies consisted primarily of highly trained heavy infantry supplemented by heavy cavalry—the famed knight protectors. Nerath's military traditions were derived from older sources. In what any dragonborn would claim to be fine dragonborn style, a special auxiliary force of devastating light infantry led many of Nerath's assaults. These were the empire's shock troopers. Military historians liken them to similar troops among other cultures and peoples, especially elves and dragonborn.

The typical shock trooper wore chainmail over leather, and carried a longsword and short sword, or dual short swords. The trooper was trained to break the line of an enemy force, moving quickly to kill and wound as many enemy soldiers as possible. If a trooper broke through the enemy line, the job then became direct assault on enemy command positions.

Although Nerath no longer exists as an empire, more than a few of its traditions linger. Numerous fighters and schools of soldiery carry on shock trooper traditions. This is to say nothing of the similar soldiers among other peoples, such as dwarf assault fighters. Any warrior who wants training in this brutal and mobile assault style can readily find it.

You are part of this sudden strike tradition of fighting. Unlike those warriors who form battle lines, you move among your enemies, defying them to strike you down and forcing them to pursue you. Your daring onslaughts confuse and astonish your adversaries. Even so, your guard is never down, especially in your favorite place: the center of a throng of foes.

「我们祖先的错误不是使用了恶魔的力量，而是没有能控制它们。」

**前提条件：提夫林**

拜尔・图拉斯的罪孽在他提夫林后人的不详外貌中显露无疑，而且毫无掩饰。弯曲的犄角，有力的尾巴，燃烧的双眼都提醒着世界――跟恶魔打交道的无比危险和可怕代价。许多提夫林克服了他们灵魂中的阴霾。但是有一些却发现很难摆脱自己罪恶血统的影响。很大程度上，是因为这些人的祖先曾经是第一批与阿斯莫迪斯和其他九层地狱魔鬼签定契约的提夫林。

**前提条件：游侠**

In the depths of the Howling Forest lies a realm of wonder and magic—the eladrin city of Shinaelestra, the legendary City of Rangers. Each night Shinaelestra shifts silently across the veil separating the Feywild from the mortal world. It appears in the forest depths for a few hours before fading back to the Feywild at sunrise. The feral monsters and savage humanoids haunting the Howling Forest have learned to give the eladrin city a wide berth, for each night the guardians of Shinaelestra range far over the twisted paths and shadowed dells in search of evil's servants.

You have dwelt among Shinaelestra's vine-covered ruins and tree-shaded manses, learning from the great ranger lords who govern the city. You might have visited the city between adventures, or perhaps you lived and studied there long ago and have now reached a sufficient level of achievement to call yourself a Shinaelestran guardian. You are welcome to return to Shinaelestra any time you wish to take up service with Lord Calenon, the ruler of the city. However, the skills you learned in the City of Rangers are in great demand throughout the world, and you can honor your old mentors by battling monsters and savagery wherever they threaten people of good heart.

title: 脱形者 Uncarnate
body:
**脱形者 Uncarnate**
「皮肤，器官，骨骼包裹着的不过是一个容器——我渴望摆脱它来从世界的束缚中得到自由。」

**前提条件：心灵术士**

脱形者的终极目标是成为纯净意识的存在，不被肉体的存在束缚。“肉体是脆弱的，而精神坚不可摧”，这一警句在心灵术士之间广为流传，但是脱形者们将它作为指导的真谛。他们寻求脱去形体，成为纯净意识和灵能意愿的载体生物。

脱形者们并不寻求如一些奥术专家选择的不死之路。虽然脱形者在使用能力时可能被误认为阴魂般的存在，然而阴魂是被不死的寒冷之链束缚着，并不是灵能力量的自生意志。

你将自己尽可能地置于最伟大的灵能挑战之下：保持意识的清晰与力量，缓缓忘记支持意识的肌肉。到了最后，除了意识都无关紧要。

**万灵之子 Scion of the All-Spirit**
「万灵将世界展现在我眼前，现在我会将这些事交给你。」

**前提条件：守望者**

尽管许多守望者都口头上认可万灵的存在，但你却欢迎万灵进入你的灵魂深处，将自己转变为万灵的强大助力，力求在你所做的一切中彰显万灵的真理。

成为万灵之子，是一种改变你人生的体验。你摒弃了你凡人生活中那些似乎无关紧要的琐事，而去拥抱了存在于万物中的伟大灵魂。尽管你仍然存在于肉体之中，但你却与万灵建立了一种灵性的共鸣，重塑了你的本质，并将你的灵魂与最伟大的原力灵魂相融合。你是万灵的纯粹代表，寻求通过运用万灵赋予你的力量来保护自然界。

title: 万事通 Jack-of-All-Trades
body:
**万事通 Jack-of-All-Trades**
「对...我能做这个，那个...还有那个。」

**前提条件：游荡者**

You are a jack-of-all-trades; learning new skills comes naturally to you, and you enjoy pitting your abilities against any challenge. Your thirst for knowledge will drive you to learn new skills until the day you die.

Since your youth, you have had an intense yearning to learn more than what books and teachers could provide. You understood from a young age that knowledge and skill can take you places that money and influence can't. You hoard knowledge the way a dragon covets its treasure, though you are happy to share it with anyone you consider worthy, or when doing so suits your fancy.

Folks might consider you a pack rat or a dabbler, but you know that the items you collect and the skills you acquire will help you in the future. And when you're there to save the day, anyone who derided your habits will realize the mistake and thank you.

Eladrin are a natural choice for this path because of their high Dexterity and Intelligence, as well as the fact that they gain an additional skill of their choice. Humans also excel as jacks-of-all-trades because of their vast variety of experiences and versatility of skill and knowledge.

prerequisite: 精灵；诗人、萨满或督军；必须信仰先祖之灵（the Spirits of the Past）
body:
**往日卫士 Keeper of the Past**
「我的先祖通过我说话，她的话对你来说可不是什么好兆头。」

**前提条件：精灵；诗人、萨满或督军；必须信仰先祖之灵（the Spirits of the Past）**

每当一个瓦伦纳的新生命降生时，往日卫士都会在场，以确定将引导这个孩子度过一生的先祖精魂是谁。当每一个瓦伦纳的生命结束时，往日卫士都会评判这名死者的一生，以确保每一个伟大的先祖精魂都能永垂不朽。以这种方式，往日卫士们引导着每一个瓦伦纳人从诞生之日到死亡之日走完他的人生。无论一名往日卫士使用何种形式的力量，他们都同样崇拜并且从受尊敬的先祖之处得到力量。往日卫士之间的区别不在于他们的力量来源，而在于他们汲取先祖力量的方式。萨满通常与守护他们的祖灵有着血缘关系，是伟大先祖的直系后代。督军则会以身作则——将先祖的训导付诸于战场。诗人们则会激励同伴们效仿古代英雄的伟业。不管以什么具体的方式，作为往日卫士，你与先祖的灵魂交流，并接受他们的建议和指导。有时候甚至是直接并使用来自先祖的光荣力量。

**前提条件：天族**

所有的天族多多少少都会有些前世的记忆，而他们也把自己当作是这些前世化身的精神后裔。对于你来说，前世的记忆更加清晰。作为一名先祖化身，你可以轻易地呼唤前世的精神――可能来自于几个世纪以前的精神――来指引你、保护你甚至是挫败你的敌人。那些冒失鬼在与你交战的时候将学会：与他们交战的不仅仅是一个今世的你，还有千千万万曾经的你。

**前提条件：神导士**

prerequisite: 任意奥术职业或「诅祝契约」职业特性，⟦维斯塔尼传统 <维斯塔尼血统> Vistani Heritage <Vistani Bloodline>⟧专长
body:
**维斯塔尼咒诅使 Vistani Execrator**
「I am the lurking sickness in your veins, the lurking fear in your mind, and the lurking stain on your soul. From me you'll receive no less than you deserve.」

**前提条件：任意奥术职业或「诅祝契约」职业特性，⟦维斯塔尼传统 <维斯塔尼血统> Vistani Heritage <Vistani Bloodline>⟧专长**

Rumor and legend speak of horrifying Vistani curses. Few are willing to put these dark parables to the test. Threat of ill fortune or a wasting disease is enough to keep the Vistani safe from numerous threats.

Folk do well to heed the folktales, because the stories are true. Of this fact you are living proof.

Although many a Vistani knows the magic to place a lasting curse on someone who has offended the clan, you are something more. In an instant, with but a glare and an oath, you can turn fortune against your adversaries. Those who dare raise their hands against you soon see the folly of their actions.

Any who show you the respect and camaraderie you deserve have little to fear. While standing beside you or watching your back, your allies benefit from the bad luck you hurl at your foes. They could even say that you bring them good fortune instead of afflicting enemies. Despite the reality, with a sly Vistani smile, you might let them believe this is true.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次攻击时，你对每个目标获得战斗优势。

title: 维祖芙使者 Herald of Vezzuvu
prerequisite: 大地锻工主题，火焰工匠主题，荒神能手主题，或「元素契约」邪术师
body:
**维祖芙使者 Herald of Vezzuvu**

**前提条件：大地锻工主题，火焰工匠主题，荒神能手主题，或「元素契约」邪术师**

Many primordials lie unconscious in their bonds, but Vezzuvu, the Queen of the Burning Mountain, still harbors both awareness and reason. Vezzuvu long ago determined that her road to freedom was to win the devotion (or fear) of mortal followers, and thereby become an elemental god. She can no longer stride the world or reign over an elemental domain, but she can still shake the mortal world by exerting her will on places of elemental power or bestowing on others the ability to call upon her essence.

As a herald of Vezzuvu, you have been gifted with a portion of the primordial's awesome abilities. You can wield this talent as you like, since Vezzuvu wants others who see your prowess to be drawn to her worship. The Queen of the Burning Mountain requires little from you most of the time, but her interests are erratic; you might walk the world for years without any messages from her, only to be sent suddenly to quell a volcanic rift, destroy the temple of an evil god, or seek out an artifact held by a frost titan.

**11级：火山抗力 Volcanic Resistance**

Your fervent adherence to Vezzuvu renders you extremely resistant to fire in all its incarnations.

**增益：**你获得10点火焰抗力，或对任何包含火焰伤害的5点抗力，选择那个让你受到更少伤害的

**11级：火山行动 Volcanic Action**

At times of great need, you draw extraordinary strength from the Queen of the Burning Mountain.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，选择火焰或雷鸣。在你下一回合结束前，你下一次攻击造成等同于一半你的等级的该类型的额外伤害。

**11级：熔岩轰炸 Lava Bomb**

Vezzuvu is a patron who lends herself to acts of destruction, as you might expect. Lava bomb allows you to bring forth a boulder-sized mass of molten lava and hurl it at your enemies.

⟦熔岩轰炸 Lava Bomb⟧

**12级：维祖芙之抚慰 Vezzuvu's Balm**

When molten rock slumbers in the marrow of your bones, fire can be a powerful restorative. This power allows you to heal yourself with an enemy's fire attack.

⟦维祖芙之抚慰 Vezzuvu's Balm⟧

**16级：火山行者 Volcanic Walk**

Vezzuvu's heralds have a supernatural affinity for volcanic phenomena and easily move in or around terrain that others would not dare to enter.

**增益：**你无视由火山环境（熔岩、灰烬或地震）造成的困难地形。你可以像在固体地面上一样在熔岩上移动。

**20级：火山之怒 Volcanic Wrath**

Those who anger Vezzuvu or her chosen servants face the most spectacular and destructive of all natural catastrophes: the searing heat and crushing power of a pyroclastic flow.

⟦火山之怒 Volcanic Wrath⟧

title: 伟大长者 Great Elder
prerequisite: 萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能，「世语精魂」职业特性
body:
**伟大长者 Great Elder**
「We never see the whole of the world, never understand it completely. But a spirit from the dawn times walks beside me, and our power does not require perfect understanding.」

**前提条件：萨满，⟦呼唤精魂伙伴 Call Spirit Companion⟧威能，「世语精魂」职业特性**

Shamans know that the spirits are not truly the size of a human, an elf, or a panther. The spirits are vast, small, or whatever they are called on to be by the world's needs. Shamans know this to be true, but not all shamans can master their unconscious expectations of the spirits. Each spirit companion appears as a creature of the shaman's size because of its link to the shaman, and as allies and friends, both share an image, a reflection, within the world of spirits.

You have seen partway through this veil. As a follower of the world speaker tradition, you know that your spirit companion is vast. By seeing part of this truth, you know that your spirit companion's size approaches that of an elder spirit, having a touch of the scope and power you will acquire if you live to fulfill an epic destiny.

As an elder spirit, your spirit companion protects your allies as it has always protected the people of the world. Its knowledge, allied with your understanding of nature, is sometimes the only shield your allies require.

**11级：长者风采 Elder Presence**

**增益：**以一个次要动作，你可以使你的精魂伙伴变为大型或中型。

**11级：伟大长者行动 Great Elder Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，邻近你的精魂伙伴的每个盟友在所有防御上获得+2加值，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：伟大精魂之触 Great Reaching Spirit**

⟦伟大精魂之触 Great Reaching Spirit⟧

**12级：伟大自然赞歌 Great Hymn of Nature**

⟦伟大自然赞歌 Great Hymn of Nature⟧

**16级：长者忠告 Elder Counsel**

**增益：**当敌人攻击邻近你精魂伙伴的盟友的意志防御时，该盟友可以选择让意志防御等同于你的。

**20级：忍无可忍 An End to Tolerance**

⟦忍无可忍 An End to Tolerance⟧

title: 位面迁移者 Planeshifter
body:
**位面迁移者 Planeshifter**
「You could argue that the sunrise in Arvandor is the most beautiful sight in all the planes—but then, you've never seen Erathis pass judgment on a wayward cleric . . .」

**前提条件：邪术师或法师**

Exploration is in your blood, but the world doesn't hold your interest. Instead, you enjoy the myriad wonders of the planes. You have extensive knowledge of the planes, and your ability to find portals and traverse dimensions is unrivaled.

**11级：位面研习 Study of the Planes**

**增益：**你获得且掌握了⟦位面传送门 Planar Portal⟧仪式，即使你没有⟦仪式施法者 Ritual Caster⟧专长，或也没有到达对应的等级。你在施展旅行类仪式的神秘检定上获得+4加值

**11级：位面迁移者行动 Planeshifter's Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，你在那回合同时获得一个额外移动动作。你可以使用该移动动作来传送10格

**11级：半位面放逐 Sequester**

⟦半位面放逐 Sequester⟧

**12级：快速传送门 Quick Portal**

⟦快速传送门 Quick Portal⟧

**16级：位置掌控 Location Mastery**

**增益：**你和离你5格内的盟友不能违抗你们的意志而传送

**20级：次元瀑布 Dimensional Cascade**

⟦次元瀑布 Dimensional Cascade⟧

title: 蔚蓝守卫 Azure Guard
prerequisite: 雅灵或精灵，必须信仰科瑞隆
body:
**蔚蓝守卫 Azure Guard**
「Corellon warns us that the Banished Darkness will one day return. When this day comes, the enemy will find us ready, and we will throw them back into the abyss from which they came.」

**前提条件：雅灵或精灵，必须信仰科瑞隆**

Lolth's return and a resumption of the disastrous war that nearly shattered the elven peoples cast a terrible shadow across Corellon's priesthood. Anticipating this event, the elders formed the Azure Guard who would one day serve as the principle leaders in repelling Lolth's demonic forces. The warriors combine prayers to Corellon with secret arcane spells to achieve the edge they need to overcome their enemies. Azure Guard members do not advertise their special status lest they invite assassins to strike at them. One cannot join the Azure Guard without invitation, and even those called to serve in its esteemed ranks may find themselves unequal to the demands the training makes.

**11级：黑暗之敌 Enemy of the Darkness**

**增益：**你在先攻检定，侦查检定和对抗毒素的豁免检定上获得+2加值。

**11级：卓越行动 Excellence in Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次攻击时，你可以重掷一个此攻击中失手的攻击骰。你必须使用第二个结果。

**11级：驱逐黑暗 Banished Darkness**

⟦驱逐黑暗 Banished Darkness⟧

**12级：阿梵多之怒 Fury of Arvandor**

⟦阿梵多之怒 Fury of Arvandor⟧

**16级：守卫传送 Shielded Teleport**

**增益：**每当你传送，你在AC和反射防御上获得+2加值直到你下一回合开始。

**20级：科瑞隆之蔚蓝赐福 Corellon's Azure Blessing**

⟦科瑞隆之蔚蓝赐福 Corellon's Azure Blessing⟧

title: 蔚蓝学者 Cerulean Adept
body:
**蔚蓝学者 Cerulean Adept**
「世界之壁比许多人怀疑的还要脆弱。恶魔与不死生物虽也是邪恶之物，但更污秽的存在觊觎着进入这个世界，享用它。在吾面前，这毫无可能。」

**前提条件：心灵术士**

一些保护者们长久以来面临着遥远国度与现实碰撞的威胁，他们被称为蔚蓝之记守护者。这些守护者们取得了一个伟大的胜利，并在有力的印记保护下隔绝了一次疯狂之权的入侵。但是正如通常发生的一样，如果没有迫在眉睫的危险去面对，保护者们渐渐在历史中淡去了身影。他们最强力的武器，即为世人所知的造物”七蓝印记“，大多数都散失或者毁灭了。

但是遥远国度继续存在着。它的存在是现实中的一枚尖刺。一些人说灵能之力自身是世界对遥远国度的回应。就像机体无意识地抗击疾病一样，宇宙通过在原住民中散布灵能种子来为日后的战役做准备。

你的灵能能力在你年幼时就提醒你日益增长的异怪的威胁。除了作为对抗异怪之卵的工具，你寻找更多强力的武器。当你处在灵能冥想的深处时，你瞥见了原始的”蔚蓝印记“。修复它们的希望很渺茫，但是你在自己的意识中构筑了它们的影像并复制下来。像其他的印记一样，你做的复制品——一个蔚蓝之记——由天蓝色背景上一棵白色的大树组成。你已经接受了这枚印记并将自己投入到世界的防线中来。

**11级：蔚蓝印记专攻 Cerulean Sign Focus**

**增益：**你在意志上获得+1加值。

**11级：蔚蓝行动 Cerulean Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点使用一个具有强化1的随意攻击威能时，你能够不花费这个灵能点而使用此强化。

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Points**

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：蔚蓝光辉 Cerulean Blaze**

⟦蔚蓝光辉 Cerulean Blaze⟧

**12级：坚实意志 Harden Mind**

⟦坚实意志 Harden Mind⟧

**16级：全知之眼 All-Seeing Eye**

**增益：**当你用一个强化的灵能威能攻击时，你掷出19-20即可造成重击。当你用一个未强化的灵能威能攻击异界生物时，你掷出18-20即可造成重击。

**20级：密封界限 Seal the Threshold**

⟦密封界限 Seal the Threshold⟧

title: 巫术大师 Witchmaster
body:
**巫术大师 Witchmaster**
「What need have we for tactics when we have strength and audacity?」

**前提条件：督军且邪术师**

Arcane magic demands much of those who would master it. It consumes time and attention. A disciplined mind is needed to bend raw energy into useful spells. Many arcane users find that the power they attain through this pursuit is sufficient: its rewards are great and the secrets unlocked are astonishing. A taste of power leads some to look beyond their dusty tomes and ritual circles to turn their power toward temporal gains. Arcanists prove capable, if not devastating, in battle, and those who dabble in leadership, commanding servants and powers beyond comprehension, prove to be some of the deadliest warlords of all.

Marrying power drawn from your pact with the martial techniques used by a warlord, you become a commanding presence on the battlefield. You twist your spells to confound your enemies while helping allies attain the best positions they can to meet the battle's demands. Even when your foes thwart your clever plans, you have a knack for finding solutions to the thorniest problems.

**11级：适应巫术 Adaptable Witchery**

**增益：**当你将要使用一个邪术师威能来进行一次远程攻击时，你可以如同你位于你视线范围内任何盟友占据的格子内来进行此攻击。如果此盟友邻近一个敌人，则你的攻击引发所有邻近你的敌人的借机攻击。否则，此攻击不会引发借机攻击。

**11级：迷魂行动 Bewitching Action**

**增益：**每当你或一个离你5格内的盟友花费一个行动点来以奥术威能进行一次攻击时，你可以滑动每个邻近你的敌人1格。

**11级：魔能飞弹 Eldritch Missile**

⟦魔能飞弹 Eldritch Missile⟧

**12级：无余之机 No Wasted Opportunity**

⟦无余之机 No Wasted Opportunity⟧

**16级：奥术风采 Arcane Presence**

**增益：**每当一个盟友将从你的「领导力」职业特性获得增益时，此盟友可以同时传送等同于你智力调整值的格子。你必须对此盟友的目的地格子拥有视线。

**20级：魔能盟友 Eldritch Allies**

⟦魔能盟友 Eldritch Allies⟧

title: 无定者 Anarchic Adept
body:
**无定者 Anarchic Adept**
「我见到了不确定性中的秩序；我触碰规律中的混乱。我即秩序与混乱的两界主宰。」

**前提条件：炽念使**

As your psionic talent matures, you find yourself focusing on the disparate nature of the disciplines you master. Focusing your thought on the edge of unpredictability in your training, you discover the latent chaos flowing through your magic. Through trial and error, you learned to master the chaos latent within your powers and unleash it against your enemies. Drawing on the power of chaos can be dangerous, but you are up to any risk you might face.

**11级：无定汹涌 Anarchic Surge**

**增益：**当你使用⟦炽念汹涌 Ardent Surge⟧时，掷一个d6。如果你掷出一个偶数，目标能以一个自由动作传送2格。如果你掷出一格奇数，将此掷骰结果加到目标恢复的生命值上

**11级：混沌行动 Chaotic Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行一次攻击时，你能选择赐予混乱之力到邻近你或邻近此攻击目标的一个盟友身上。掷一个d6决定效果

d6 | 混沌行动效果

    1 | 无效果

    2 | 此盟友以一个自由动作快步

    3 | 此盟友在攻击骰上获得+1威能加值，直到你下一回合结束

    4 | 此盟友获得等同于你魅力调整值的临时生命值

    5 | 此盟友在他下一次攻击的伤害骰上获得等同于你魅力调整值的加值

    6 | 此盟友能以一个自由动作进行一次基本攻击

**11级：典范灵能点 Paragon Power Points**

**增益：**你获得2个额外灵能点。

**11级：无定打击 Anarchic Strike**

⟦无定打击 Anarchic Strike⟧

**12级：无束混沌 Chaos Unbound**

⟦无束混沌 Chaos Unbound⟧

**16级：惑中清明 Clarity in Confusion**

**增益：**你不会因晕眩或震慑而提供战斗优势。另外，当你晕眩时，你能在此状态允许的一个动作之外进行一个额外的次要动作

**20级：混沌裂隙 Chaos Breach**

⟦混沌裂隙 Chaos Breach⟧

title: 无缚元素 Element Unchained
body:
**无缚元素 Element Unchained**
「现在我自由了——可以来踢你的屁股了。.」

**前提条件：元素裔**

Ameth's closest friend and advisor, Sot-Olmat, pioneered a discipline of rigorous mastery over the elements within a genasi. It is a discipline that one can master through a combination of meditation on a simple mantra and a series of exercises that look harmless but serve to unlock elemental potential within the genasi. The mantra is a repetition in Primordial regarding one's elemental affinity: “Fire cannot be chained,” or “Water cannot be chained.” Some manifestations require the mantra be changed: “Earth is not chained; earth is the chain.” “Acid consumes all chains.” Sot-Olmat developed this path while a slave, and he continues to expose himself to danger to teach the rudiments of it to other enslaved genasi.

A genasi who studies this discipline becomes impossible to bind or cage. He or she can escape bonds of all sorts swiftly, becoming a master of escape artistry through the mastery of the elemental nature innate to every genasi.

**11级：元素释放 Elements Unleashed**

**增益：**当你使用一个遭遇或每日攻击威能，你可以造成任何你的显能提供给你抗力的伤害类型，而不是此攻击正常造成的伤害类型。

**11级：解放行动 Liberating Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行额外动作时，你和所有距离你5格内的盟友无视迟缓，定身和束缚状态，直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：元素喷发 Elemental Eruption**

⟦元素喷发 Elemental Eruption⟧

**12级：元素移位 Elemental Transposition**

⟦元素移位 Elemental Transposition⟧

**16级：无缚之击 Unchained Assault**

**增益：**当你在迟缓，定身或束缚时以一次攻击命中，你结束正在影响你的迟缓，定身或束缚状态。

**20级：复制体逃脱 Duplicate Escape**

⟦复制体逃脱 Duplicate Escape⟧

title: 无赖王子 Prince of Knaves
body:
**无赖王子 Prince of Knaves**
「劫富济贫，没错。我们最贪婪！」

**前提条件：督军，在隐秘上受训**

Those who live outside the law are fiercely independent. Some are outcasts by nature, but most are driven to the fringes of society because a rigid authority denied them any other place. It's not easy for free spirits to acknowledge their need for leadership. You understand that those who act alone are easier to hunt down. Outlaws must be inspired to band together for their common good. That's where you come in.

Because of your charm and your bravado, and because you never give up, you're the one they rely on for this inspiration. When times are good, you're the one they trust to divvy up the loot. On the days when the law wins, it's you who holds despair at bay and encourages your band to press on. You are a prince of knaves, and no matter what company you keep or how base you might be, none can deny that you have the dignity and magnetism of a born ruler.

A few heroes who follow this path truly are of noble birth. Legends abound with tales of deposed aristocrats toppled from the ruling class and forced to lead a ragtag band of rebels to recapture their rightful heritage. Others hope to use their blades and their wits to carve out a new throne for themselves. Whatever the past and the future hold for you, you know that you will triumph as long as you have your friends close—and a concealed knife even closer.

**11级：分心行动 Distracting Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作，你可见的每名盟友能以其速度快步并以一个自由动作进行一次隐秘检定来隐藏。

title: 无情裁决者 Ruthless Punisher
body:
**无情裁决者 Ruthless Punisher**
「The most dangerous foes are those who know the difference between right and wrong yet choose to do evilThey also understand what dying really means.」

**前提条件：游侠**

For a mundane hunter or a common would-be hero, ordinary animals and beastlike monsters are worthy prey. Regardless of what such a creature is physically capable of, or the wrongs it's responsible for, it has only raw instinct or brutish cunning to use against its antagonist. Reaction is its only course. The beast lacks the abilities to reason and to plan, which are required for any but the most mindless of evil acts.

Humanoid creatures seldom suffer from this lack, this banality. Even a semblance of human intelligence, combined with the ability to use weapons and other skills, makes an adversary that much more dangerous. From common goblins to demon lords and deities, the most numerous wicked creatures in the cosmos live inside various humanoid frames. The form is similar enough in each instance that knowledge of one is a help against another, no matter how different the seeming. Malevolent or not, few creatures offer the challenge that a humanoid quarry does.

Long ago, whether for vengeance, righteousness, or pure gamesmanship, you chose to specialize in facing and taking out humanoid foes. You excel at tracking and opposing such canny foes, slaying the many who deserve death and retrieving a few for reward, profit, or justice. For you, the understanding of anatomy, the inflicting of pain, and the invoking of fear are weapons as effective as sword or bow.

You've been so successful that you have developed a merciless reputation. The mention of your name inspires terror among those who know they must face you. One day, you're sure, a humanoid adversary of mythic scope will tremble at your approach.

**11级：冷酷攻击 Ruthless Action**

**增益：**你可以花费一个行动点，重掷任何一次对你的标的且标的为人型目标的攻击骰，而不是进行额外动作。

title: 无情杀手 Relentless Slayer
prerequisite: 神罚使，⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧威能
body:
**无情杀手 Relentless Slayer**
「我是你的克星。」

**前提条件：神罚使，⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧威能**

Many avengers find themselves confronting some great threat, such as a group of drow seeking to enslave a surface kingdom, an incursion of demons, a cult of Tharizdun worshipers, or an empire of vampires secretly ruling over human cities. Whatever the threat might be, it is dire enough to drive you to an old and powerful rite of sacred commitment. Through prayerful vigils, you have invested your oath of enmity with tremendous potency. All avengers rely on oath of enmity, but you draw on yours to perform exceptional feats in battle.

As a relentless slayer, you are always alert for signs that your enemies are at work. Your adventures often lead you away from a longtime adversary for weeks or months at a time, but you know that you have a sacred duty to which you must eventually return.

**选择一个杀手敌人**

与你的DM协商，为你的角色选择一个合适的敌人。它应该是你一种你以前面对过的怪物，且是DM计划在后续冒险中偶尔出现的。一个杀手敌人是一种特定群体的怪物——譬如，恶魔，魔鬼，卓尔，火焰巨人，牛头人，或吸血鬼

**11级：杀手的誓言 Slayer's Oath**

**增益：**当你使用⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧时，你可以指定第二个敌人为目标，只要它是你的杀手敌人（见上述）。此外，当你进行攻击检定且能因为⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧掷两次攻击检定时，你可以在掷第一次攻击骰前决定放弃第二次攻击骰。如果你这样做，则你此攻击造成2d6额外伤害。

**11级：致命行动 Lethal Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点对你⟦圣仇宣言 Oath of Enmity⟧的目标进行攻击时，此攻击掷出18-20即可造成重击。

**11级：杀手的开局 Slayer's Gambit**

**12级：冷酷热情 Relentless Fervor**

⟦冷酷热情 Relentless Fervor⟧

**16级：无情决心 Relentless Determination**

**增益：**当你对一个由敌人导致的效果豁免失败时，你的神术攻击威能造成5点额外伤害直到你下一回合结束。

title: 无双猎人 Peerless Hunter
body:
**无双猎人 Peerless Hunter**

**前提条件：游侠（猎人）**

You are an expert with ranged weapons—matched by few, surpassed by none.

**11级：猎人行动 Hunter's Action**

As a peerless hunter, you develop a deadly instinct for combat. Even when you push yourself beyond normal limits in battle, that instinct guides your hand to deadly effect.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点来进行一次攻击时，在你回合结束前，你可以重掷每个攻击骰，且你必须使用第二个结果

**11级：进阶破坏射击 Improved Disruptive Shot**

Through constant practice, you improve your ability to use your most accurate attacks.

**增益：**你每场遭遇可再多使用一次⟦破坏射击 Disruptive Shot⟧威能，但你仍然每回合只能使用一次

**11级：优越射艺 Superior Archery**

Your endless hours of training with the bow or crossbow lend unequaled speed to your attacks. Your hands are a blur in combat as you fire and reload, letting you take advantage of every successful strike to unleash a follow-up that cuts through the ranks of your foes.

**增益：**你获得下列与你「专业射手」的威能相关联的收益

✦ **瞄准射击：**如果你的⟦瞄准射击 Aimed Shot⟧失手，则目标受到一半伤害

✦** 机敏射击：**如果你的⟦机敏射击 Clever Shot⟧失手，则你可以滑动目标1格

✦ **快速射击：**当你使用⟦快速射击 Rapid Shot⟧时，你不会在攻击骰上受到-2减值

**12级：猎手抓捕陷阱 Hunter's Grasping Trap**

You have learned from hard experience that controlling the enemy's maneuvers is the key to victory. An enemy bogged down is one that quickly falls to your hail of arrows.

⟦猎手抓捕陷阱 Hunter's Grasping Trap⟧

**16级：威胁射艺 Threatening Archery**

You are so well versed in handling your ranged weapon that you can load it and attack in the blink of an eye. When an enemy drops its guard, you snap off a shot to take advantage of its defenseless position.

**增益：**如果一个邻近的敌人引发了你的借机攻击，则你能对它进行一次远程基本攻击，而不是近战基本攻击

**20级：大师猎人 Master Hunter**

You are a hunter without equal, attacking with such accuracy that you no longer need optimal positioning or distraction to get the better of your foes.

**增益：**当你以远程武器攻击离你5格内的敌人时，你对他们获得战斗优势

title: 无畏斥候 Intrepid Scout
body:
**无畏斥候 Intrepid Scout**

**前提条件：游侠（斥候）**

Your mastery of two weapon fighting combines with your focus and speed to grant you unmatched mobility.

**11级：斥候行动 Scout's Action**

You count on being able to freely combine movement with your attacks to keep a constant advantage over your foes. When you push yourself past your limits, you summon up a surge of speed that lets you slip across the battlefield with ease.

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行额外动作时，在此额外动作之前或之后你能以最多你的速度快步

**11级：斥候机动 Scout's Mobility**

Your tireless stride lets you cover more ground than other characters can.

**增益：**你在速度上获得+1加值

**11级：进阶强力打击 Improved Power Strike**

You make an additional devastating attack during any battle.

**增益：**你每场遭遇可再多使用一次⟦强力打击 Power Strike⟧威能，但你仍然每回合只能使用一次

**12级：斥候跨步 Scout's Stride**

You thrive on staying in motion at the center of combat, and your pursuit of the intrepid scout path lets you augment your natural speed with primal power.

⟦斥候跨步 Scout's Stride⟧

**16级：荒野之速 Speed of the Wild**

Your natural agility and speed draw on your mastery of primal power to provide you freedom of movement in the widest range of environments. Whether you are fighting in the treetops, traversing the summit of a mountain peak, or fording a rushing stream, no foe can elude you for long.

**增益：**你获得等同于你速度的攀爬速度和游泳速度

**20级：孤立突击 Isolated Assault**

As you reach the peak of the paragon tier, your foes have learned to fear your presence on the battlefield. With no enemies or allies to shield it from your wrath, a chosen foe grants you the advantage.

**增益：**你对任何除你之外不邻近任何生物的敌人的近战武器攻击获得战斗优势

title: 无畏投石手 Daring Slinger
body:
**无畏投石手 Daring Slinger**
「一石二鸟…一发双卓尔怎么样？」

**前提条件：游荡者**

The sling is a humble weapon, favored by commoners such as shepherds and farmers. It is useful for chasing off predators and bandits, but it lacks the prestige enjoyed by crossbows and light blades. Despite its lowly stature, the sling has its adherents. Among these enthusiasts, the daring slinger is the most dangerous, for these rogues elevate the simple weapon, making it the equal of any other ranged weapon.

As a daring slinger, you appreciate the weapon's subtle assets. A sling is small. It can be compressed and hidden. Slings are also resistant to the elements. You can dunk one in water, stretch it, or abuse it, and the weapon continues to work—something that can't be said of bows and crossbows. Best of all, ammunition is never a problem; any small stone will do.

Through extensive training, you've improved your accuracy, exceeding what archers can do with a longbow. Your range is equal to that of a crossbow, and your bullets pack an equal punch.

**11级：震荡行动 Concussive Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点以投石索进行攻击且命中时，你将伤害骰中的1或2视为掷出了3。另外，此攻击的目标晕眩直到你下一回合结束。

**11级：投石索大师 Sling Mastery**

**增益：**你在使用投石索进行的武器攻击的伤害骰上获得+2加值，此加值在21级时增加至+4。

⟦有利失手 Instructive Miss⟧

**增益：**你在使用投石索进行攻击时，忽略因最大射程导致的-2减值并且忽略由敌人的盟友提供的掩护。

title: 无畏战士 Dreadnought
body:
**无畏战士 Dreadnought**
「你无法妨碍我，更别说阻止我！」

**前提条件：战士**

World-shaking battles were fought between the tieflings of Bael Turath and the dragonborn of Arkhosia. The deeds and exploits of those conflicts resound still in epic story and song. One such anthem is Lament of the Dreadnought, a somber song that recounts the final march of Jagannash the Unstoppable, a great dragonborn hero.

A doughty warrior famed for his ability to fight on no matter the injuries he sustained, Jagannash accumulated a number of legends. He withstood the full fury of an angry blue dragon, shrugged off the lashes of a pit fiend's whip, and even killed a tiefling warlock who had hurled him through Hell. The Lament, though, speaks of his final battle and all he achieved in the last offensive against the tiefling empire. Jagan nash felled a full legion of devils, strangled their succubus sorceress commander with his bare hands, and hammered his way through the walls of a fortress. He was climbing the tower that housed the tiefling war room when the earth rebelled and swallowed the citadel and all within it. It is whispered that Jagannash fights there still, despite the centuries. Such is his resilience.

It is from Jagannash's example that other fighters who follow a similar creed take inspiration. The mind– body practices of these warriors are kept and taught by a few masters, dragonborn and otherwise. Some even develop these talents without formal training.

As a dreadnought, you are an inexorable force of destruction. You turn aside weapons with nothing more than your force of will. Fire cannot touch you; lightning cannot blind you. The core of your might grows from your ability to detach your mind from your body, to disassociate yourself from the pain of your wounds and press onward to keep fighting when others would succumb. You attain this state through discipline and a commitment. All who attempt to stand against you are bound to fall.

**11级：无畏之势 Dreadnought Action**

**增益：**当你花费一个行动点进行攻击时，你获得10点全伤害抗力直到你下回合开始。

**11级：急中生智 Unfailing Resources**

**增益：**你的最大生命值增加10点。你可以用一个次要动作，以自己受到10点伤害为代价立即终止一个可以被豁免终止的效果。你必须至少拥有10点生命值才能使用此能力，且无法使用任何手段来减免此伤害。

title: 无形法师 Unseen Mage
body:
**无形法师 Unseen Mage**
「Have you ever met someone who wasn't there?」

**前提条件：法师**

通过心灵深处魔法力量带来的能力，观察他人却不为人知，带给这个世界变化但又不为所动。你将自己献给了隐形的艺术，你能将你的身体呈现得像没有丝豪瑕疵的透明玻璃，没有任何证明你存在的迹象。你就是一位无形法师；没有什么能阻止你。或者更准确地说，看到你。

由于你能够很轻易地消失，你必须控制自己的步伐，避免被盟友绊到。当你隐形并走在大街上时，也得格外小心，以防一些不知情的马车和轿子撞到你。同时，你也必须保持谨慎，以防这种强大的能力被滥用。

title: 无形之手 Unseen Hand-Paragon Path
body:
**无形之手 Unseen Hand-Paragon Path**
「我是无形之刃，影中杀手，最终清算。」

**前提条件：武僧，在隐秘上受训**

A covert clan of enigmatic monks engage in assassination, espionage, and sabotage. They are mercenaries, taking commissions from the powerful or the vengeful. Members of the Unseen Hand are bound to the order for life—the clan's mysteries are too sensitive to allow any member to withdraw or resign.

Secrecy and subtlety lie at the heart of your training. As long as your enemies cannot identify your purpose, you have them at a disadvantage. You might achieve this subterfuge through cunning disguises, skulking through shadows, or misdirection. Mastering the higher mysteries helps you manipulate darkness, leap across vast distances, and penetrate your enemies' minds.

Being a trained killer is not so different from being any other kind of warrior, but you must ensure that your tactics and techniques do not alarm your companions. At the same time, you must maintain friendly relations with the Unseen Hand clan or face ostracism, retribution—or worse.

**11级：无形之道武装 Arms of the Unseen Way**

**增益：**你获得手弩的擅长。当你使用你的「疾风连击」威能时，你能通过发射你持握的已经装填好的手弩来使此威能以离你10格内的一个额外生物作为目标。这不会引发借机攻击。

title: 无约游牧者 Unbound Nomad
body:
**无约游牧者 Unbound Nomad**
「I sail the seas of possibility, bound for a fate I choose.」

**前提条件：战魂**

Hidden pathways and secret portals riddle the world and the planes. You possess the keen eye and open mind that let you pick out these shortcuts and exploit them. Your understanding of planar mechanics might be instinctive, originating in an unusual knack for sensing and locating such anomalies. It might be the result of extensive training, in which you learned from a master unbound nomad how to circumvent the bounds of reality. However you came by your knowledge, you can travel unseen byways with ease.

As an unbound nomad, you are rarely in one place for long. You use your talent to slip through the cracks in the world around you, then reappear wherever you want. You can dodge through new gateways to escape a persistent enemy, or force your foes into the unseen spaces between the planes. Your unpredictability leaves your enemies confused, chasing after phantoms as you take charge of the battlefield around them.

title: 武装吟游诗人 Arms-Troubadour
body:
**武装吟游诗人 Arms-Troubadour**
Artistry can be found in anything, young lord—especially swordplay. My earnest advice is to do nothing that you cannot do well.

**前提条件：阿塔斯歌手主题**

Throughout the Seven Cities of the Tyr Region, nobles surround themselves with retainers of good education, charming manners, and mastery of the arts. Many of these kept artists are just fops or decoration, but some are more than entertaining companions—they are skilled duelists and treasured advisors, deadly warriors never more than a few steps from their patron's side. In addition to beautifying the noble household with poetry and song, troubadours of this sort often serve as arms-instructors to young nobles and elite bodyguards trusted with the very lives of their patrons.

Arms-troubadours are typically well educated, literate, skilled in an instrument or two, noteworthy poets, and equipped with aristocratic manners and refinement. Some begin as minor nobility attending wealthier and more important nobles, whereas others are descended from well-off merchants or commoners who set out to master the courtier's skills and seek out noble patronage. Most remain with a patron for a year or two before moving on, but others—especially those who come to be trusted as advisors and companions—might spend all their lives in a single noble's service.

As an arms-troubadour, you might have a patron whose interests you look after during your adventures, or you could be between patrons. If so, given your fame and skill, your services might be very highly sought-after.

**11级：娴熟行动 Skillful Action**

title: 吸血鬼贵族 Vampire Noble
body:
**吸血鬼贵族 Vampire Noble**

**前提条件：吸血鬼**

A vampire noble concentrates on a particular set of vampiric traits to emphasize them, creating a suite of abilities that vampires refer to as a bloodline. Some vampires choose the cunning of the beguiler bloodline, while others prefer to cultivate their bestial nature by adopting the stalker bloodline.

两种血统——⟦欺诈者血统 Beguiler Bloodline⟧和⟦追猎者血统 Stalker Bloodline⟧——可供选择

Your hunger grows with your power, allowing you to channel the life energy of your foes to even deadlier effect.

When you push yourself beyond normal limits, you also spark the supernatural energy that animates your undead body, letting you strike with superior accuracy and speed.

**16级：血统特性 Bloodline Feature**

The dark traditions of your bloodline bestow additional benefit and help you shrug off the lingering weakness of your vampiric form.

**20级：血统每日威能 Bloodline Daily Power**

At the height of the paragon tier, your dark curse fuels your deadliest attack.

**增益：**你获得1个与你的血统相关联的典范威能

title: 西维斯真名者 Sivis Truenamer
prerequisite: ⟦抄录之龙纹 <龙纹> Mark of Scribing <Dragonmark>⟧专长，流利使用天界语
body:
**西维斯真名者 Sivis Truenamer**
「我称呼你为thaukrala'them-sholowdi。我指责你mahanaprill-katarnah。并且听从这个命令：Quarranquatalli'voreshathayue!」

**前提条件：⟦抄录之龙纹 <龙纹> Mark of Scribing <Dragonmark>⟧专长，流利使用天界语**
